name: Clean Energy Advisors
description: Clean Energy Advisors is a privately‑held firm headquartered in Cheyenne, Wyoming, that provides clean‑energy consulting, asset‑management and financial advisory services. It helps homeowners across multiple U.S. states select solar, battery storage, EV chargers and other renewable‑energy products, while also creating investment opportunities for impact investors in sustainable energy projects.

name: Trio
description: Trio‑Tech International (NYSE MKT: TRT) is a California‑based provider of semiconductor back‑end testing services and industrial electronics solutions. The company serves global semiconductor makers and industrial customers, operating primarily in the United States and Asia.
